# Wordsworth Language Centre

> Wordsworth Language Centre is an English language centre in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
> It teaches adults, teens and young learners with immersive courses, expert teachers
> and a supportive community.

## Courses

- Adults and professionals: general English, IELTS and business English.
- Teens: Cambridge exam preparation (IGCSE English as a Second Language), public speaking and study skills.
- Young learners: phonics, creative and confidence clubs.
- A placement test helps the centre recommend the best class pathway for each learner.
- Outside the classroom, learners join community trips and events, such as waterfall and hill walks and a treasure hunt.

## Contact

- Address: A-8-4, Megan Avenue, 2, Jalan Yap Kwan Seng, Wilayah Persekutuan, 50450 Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
- Email: info@wordsworth.edu.my
- Phone: 0175045565
